name: move_path
description: Rename or move a wiki file or directory. Works for both `.md` documents and folders (folders move recursively, preserving everything inside). Content is unchanged — this is a pure rename. The old path must exist; the new path must not. Returns the commit SHA, the resolved old/new paths, and the list of every tracked file that was moved (useful when the source was a directory).

old_path.description: Wiki-relative path of the existing file or directory to move (e.g. `auth/passwords.md` or `auth`).

new_path.description: Wiki-relative destination path. For a `.md` file this should also end in `.md`; for a directory it must not. Parent directories are created as needed.

commit_message.description: Short commit message summarizing the move (e.g. "rename auth/ to identity/").
